timingBoundary: One local Node observation of first lazy material/data construction versus cached lookup after module imports; not actor frame time, GPU upload time or device latency.

texture.owner: Module singleton shared by cached Mira upper-materials. Retained for existing template/module lifetime, as original microtextures; no scene-quality/title churn, no asynchronous callback, no disposal API introduced.

boundary: GPU payload is arithmetic RGBA8+mips, not measured allocation/driver overhead/peak process memory. CPU texture data remains retained; no texture clone per actor. Image-loader retry/failure/release is not applicable because no asynchronous image exists; coarse surface uses standard mip filtering on all existing quality levels.
